ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two unconnected chemical structures, and there are several curved arrows; the question requires ignoring these arrows. The structure on the left is an amide: the nitrogen atom is connected to two methyl groups, and connected to a formyl carbon, this carbon forms a carbonyl double bond with oxygen and is also connected to one hydrogen. The structure on the right is a phosphoryl chloride structure: phosphorus forms a double bond with one oxygen, and is connected to three chlorine atoms. Reasoning: After ignoring the arrows, the molecule on the left is N,N-dimethylformamide, whose neutral SMILES is CN(C)C=O. The molecule on the right is POCl3, whose SMILES is O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl. The two molecules are disconnected from each other, therefore connect them with a dot.

method.method_draft: Describe the image contents, then convert each disconnected drawn molecule into its neutral SMILES. Ignore all curved arrows as instructed. For the left molecule, recognize the N attached to two methyl groups and to a formyl carbonyl as N,N-dimethylformamide, giving CN(C)C=O. For the right molecule, recognize POCl3 as O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl. Combine the two components with a dot to obtain CN(C)C=O.O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个不相连的化学结构，并带有若干弯箭头；题目要求忽略这些箭头。左侧结构是一个酰胺：氮原子连着两个甲基，并连到一个甲酰基碳，该碳与氧形成羰基双键且还连有一个氢。右侧结构是一个磷酰氯结构：磷与一个氧形成双键，并与三个氯原子相连。推理：忽略箭头后，左侧分子为 N,N-二甲基甲酰胺，其中性 SMILES 为 CN(C)C=O。右侧分子为 POCl3，其 SMILES 为 O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl。两个分子彼此断开，因此用点号连接。

planner_metadata.image_role: First identify the two disconnected structures in the image: on the left, a formamide carbonyl with an H on the carbonyl carbon and a nitrogen bearing two methyl groups, i.e. N,N-dimethylformamide; on the right, a phosphorus atom double-bonded to oxygen and single-bonded to three chlorines, i.e. phosphoryl chloride. planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES rules: disconnected molecules are joined with a dot; N,N-dimethylformamide can be written as CN(C)C=O, with the aldehydic/formyl H implicit; phosphoryl chloride can be written as O=P(Cl)(Cl)Cl.
